recommendation_summary: The reply recommends adding one failure alert for `nightly-sync` on `edna` now: either a cron wrapper that emails on non-zero exit, or a dead-man's-switch ping in the style of healthchecks.io that alerts if the job hasn't checked in by 03:10. It defers the Synology/Docker central log until there are several services worth searching.
note: The reply offers two interchangeable ways to build one alert and defers the central log, but none of the four labelled record lines appear.
